source_findings.observation: Each live activation reaches the engine-default hook after debounce. A retained A image is current only when both request and active ticket match; successful publication stores the new ticket, pixels, backend and validity together. The old local completed-frame early return is removed.

Pipeline begin does not supersede live current work for an already-cancelled caller. The SwiftUI task also guards cancellation before assigning its ticket or clearing a failure. The source36 deterministic pipeline test covers begin; it does not execute SwiftUI task scheduling.

Ticket and Task.isCancelled are checked before rendering, after suspension, after conversion and before error publication. Stale success/failure and invalidation during conversion are covered by the unchanged pipeline tests. Synchronous publication follows the last guard; no claim of atomicity with an external cancellation after that guard.

Only a same-subject successful prior frame can stand in for a different request; a mismatched-subject image or mismatched-request error is hidden. Retained validity counts are explicitly previous-qualified. Inactive work starts a new pipeline ticket and clears activeTicket; disappearance invalidates and clears it. A matching existing error can remain unavailable while inactive; no renderer runs for nil activeRequest.

One host/observable holder retains view identity through A-B-A. Explicit B and A2 continuations plus two-A/one-B invocation counts and initial/held/final AX positive controls target the adoption bug. B only flips a mock boolean and later manually throws StudyError.cancelled; fixtures supply Metal/CPU labels. No actual engine downgrade, GPU execution or cancellation delivery is demonstrated. The host forces active scenePhase and sphere.

Pixel checkpoints permit at most eight further evaluations after cancellation immediately following a false poll. Setup/final polls and observed final engine cancellation prevent return/cache admission. The 80 ms task debounce is separate from this work bound. No suspension occurs between final engine check and retain; external cancellation after that final false poll remains a completion-boundary limitation, not a demonstrated precompletion cache-publication failure.

Actual engine downgrade followed by cancellation and authoritative A lookup requires a distinct engine/native scenario; synthetic backend labels and a manually thrown cancellation cannot establish it.
